title: Universal Vertices and Saturation Numbers for Disjoint Triangles
summary: A graph $G$ is $\mathcal F$-saturated if $G$ contains no member of $\mathcal F$, but the addition of any non-edge creates a copy of a member of $\mathcal F$. For $m\ge 1$, let $(m+1)K_3$ denote the vertex-disjoint union of $(m+1)$ triangles. In this paper, we study $(m+1)K_3$-saturated graphs. We construct a family of $(m+1)K_3$-saturated graphs which gives the uniform upper bound $\operatorname{sat}((m+1)K_3,n)=O(n^{3/2})$ for all $m\ge 1$ and $n\ge 3m+3$.
